Definition: to approach; hence, to meet in various senses
BiblicalUsage: 1) to meet, encounter, approach, be opportune; 1a) (Piel) to allow to meet, cause to meet; 1b) (Pual) to be sent, be allowed to meet; 1c) (Hithpael) to seek occasion (quarrel), cause oneself to meet
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
